tagline: GridCraft on a Selkies web desktop: a spreadsheet with formulas and charts that opens and saves Excel workbooks.
description: GridCraft, a spreadsheet that opens and saves Excel .xlsx workbooks, on a Selkies web desktop. It runs in your browser without a VNC client or a local install, on amd64 and arm64.
author: Junker der Provinz
title: GridCraft
